description: Label-free unknown binary stream analysis that gives equal weight to the first four observed bytes when proposing message-type partitions. It contains no protocol name, field definition, truth label, or decoder output.
limitations: This profile assumes repeated early bytes may act as a type discriminator; that is a statistical hypothesis, not a protocol definition.
Only repeated length-prefixed hypotheses that cover the complete input are accepted automatically.
Message clusters are statistical groups, not confirmed protocol message types.
Field candidates and length relations are hypotheses; encrypted, compressed, delimited, or fixed-length formats can correctly remain unframed.
